funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage in their career; must have a publisher confirmed and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles reflecting advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed; only one grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or non‑profit; exhibition may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions, disseminating new research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support organisations in disseminating research through live, online or hybrid events and programming.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit with items in public or charitable ownership; project must involve conservation research leading to a research outcome.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help organisations undertake vital conservation research on items from their own collections of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of their own collections related to British art.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to digitise collections, making material freely available online and enhancing access to British art resources.
